Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBag: Keeps food fresh inside a cooler. Melts slowly in a cooler, quickly anywhere else, and refreezes in a powered fridge or freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freeze: Leave it in the powered freezer for %1 hours. Every %2 units of water becomes one bag of ice, adding up across everything you set to freeze in there.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freezing: %1 of the %2 units needed for a bag are set to freeze in here. Ready in about %3 hours.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezingShort: Only %1 units of water are set to freeze in here, and a bag needs %2. Set more to freeze in the same fridge and they add up; until then nothing will come of it.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_NoPower: This refrigerator has no power. Water only freezes in one that is running.
